605:t_000:4.en:
$$アルト$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$... Is $$アムブリエル$$ coming?」

605:t_000:6.en:
$$宗介$$
「Judging by what she said when she left last time, this will be our final battle with her.」

605:t_000:7.en:
$n
(Just defeating her isn't enough. I have to save Miss $$スズネ$$ from inside her...)

605:t_000:8.en:
$n
(But... is that really the right thing to do...?)

605:t_000:9.en:
$$アムロ$$
「It seems the Empire also wants to prevent the truth of the Box from being revealed.」

605:t_000:10.en:
$$キラ$$
「That's... about $$クロノ$$'s doctrine, rather than political participation for the new humanity, right?」

605:t_000:11.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Is that right, Ensign $$リディ$$?」

605:t_000:13.en:
$$シン$$
「Even after coming this far, you're keeping silent?」

605:t_000:15.en:
$$リディ$$
「The truth at the very heart of $$ラプラスの箱$$... I'm not the one who should tell it.」

605:t_000:16.en:
$$リディ$$
「I suspect it's set to be revealed when the true $$宇宙世紀$$ Charter is disclosed.」

605:t_000:17.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「That's the secret in the deepest part of the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$'s $$ヴェーダ$$... Level 8...」

605:t_000:18.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Is there some connection between $$ＵＣＷ$$'s $$宇宙世紀$$ and $$ＡＤＷ$$'s $$ソレスタルビーイング$$?」

605:t_000:19.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Apparently, $$サイアム・ビスト$$ mentioned the names $$イオリア・シュヘンベルグ$$ and $$エルガン・ローディック$$.」

605:t_000:20.en:
$$刹那$$
「$$ヴェーダ$$ was preparing to reveal the truth of $$ラプラスの箱$$ to the world too. There must be a connection between them.」

605:t_000:21.en:
$$オットー$$
「So we'll soon know everything...」

605:t_001:0.en:
$$リディ$$
(Now the question is whether humanity can accept it...)

605:t_001:2.en:
$$リディ$$
「I believe in humanity too, you know.」

605:t_001:3.en:
$$リディ$$
「The blood of $$リカルド・マーセナス$$, who opposed $$クロノ$$, runs in my veins too.」

605:t_001:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You're you, $$リディ$$. $$クロノ$$ and your family have nothing to do with it.」

605:t_001:5.en:
$$リディ$$
「Hearing you say that makes me feel a little better.」

605:t_001:6.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$... Now that you've opened your heart, I'm sure you can change.」

605:t_001:8.en:
$$リディ$$
(You saved both me and $$アルベルト$$...)

605:t_001:9.en:
$$リディ$$
(That's why I'll protect you. You, $$バナージ$$, $$ミネバ$$... and humanity's future...)

605:t_001:11.en:
$$オットー$$
「All units, prepare to intercept!」

605:t_002:0.en:
$$リディ$$
(Now the question is whether humanity can accept it...)

605:t_002:2.en:
$$リディ$$
「I believe in humanity too, you know.」

605:t_002:3.en:
$$リディ$$
「The blood of $$リカルド・マーセナス$$, who opposed $$クロノ$$, runs in my veins too.」

605:t_002:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You're you, $$リディ$$. $$クロノ$$ and your family have nothing to do with it.」

605:t_002:5.en:
$$リディ$$
「Hearing you say that makes me feel a little better.」

605:t_002:6.en:
$$リディ$$
($$マリーダ$$... I swear I'll protect $$バナージ$$ and $$ミネバ$$...)

605:t_002:7.en:
$$リディ$$
(That's the atonement I can offer for taking your life.)

605:t_002:9.en:
$$オットー$$
「All units, prepare to intercept!」

605:t_003:0.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「I'm impressed. You not only defeated $$ネオ・ジオン$$, you even took that $$バルビエル$$ down a peg.」

605:t_003:2.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「But thanks to you, $$バルビエル$$'s hatred will grow even stronger...」

605:t_003:3.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「To keep him from lording it over me, I'll be taking $$ジェミニオン$$ back here.」

605:t_003:4.en:
$$甲児$$
「You're the one lording it over everyone!」

605:t_003:5.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Hey, you stuck-up woman! Today you're giving Miss $$スズネ$$ back!」

605:t_003:6.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Enough prattle. We haven't got much time, so let's get started.」

605:t_003:8.en:
$$アルト$$
「You intend to stop the disclosure of $$ラプラスの箱$$?!」

605:t_003:9.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Well, that's the idea.」

605:t_003:10.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「We may not have long, but let's enjoy ourselves, $c!」

605:t_003:11.en:
$n
「I have no intention of doing that.」

605:t_003:12.en:
$n
「Here I come, $$アムブリエル$$! I won't give you $$ジェミニオン・レイ$$ or Miss $$スズネ$$!」

605:t_004:0.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「$$ヴェーダ$$ has infiltrated the Earth Sphere's communications systems!」

605:t_004:1.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「The Empire is using Earth's existing infrastructure too, so it won't be able to stop this easily.」

605:t_004:2.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「It looks like old man $$イオリア$$ expected this day to come.」

605:t_004:3.en:
$$フェルト$$
「Transmission from $$メガラニカ$$ is starting!」

605:t_005:1.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「It looks like it's started.」

605:t_005:2.en:
$n
「Do you intend to stop the broadcast by force?」

605:t_005:3.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「That's right. ...Though personally, I don't care either way.」

605:t_005:5.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Here I come, $n! Both I and the other self inside me are interested in you!」

605:t_007:1.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「For you, that is.」

605:t_007:3.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Too bad. Even if you defeat me, your beloved Miss $$スズネ$$ isn't coming back!」

605:t_007:5.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「It's true. I can't feel her presence inside me anymore.」

605:t_007:7.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「But it's also true that you've beaten me. I have no intention of living in disgrace.」

605:t_007:9.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Heh... It should be about time.」

605:t_008:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You felt it too, $$バナージ$$?!」

605:t_008:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「A light... of hatred is coming!」
